whatChangedAndWhy: The account has posted nothing since 2026-10-11: the daily draft run failed 10-12, 10-13 and 10-14, all three with 'You've hit your weekly limit' — the Claude account's weekly usage cap, not a bug in this desk (filed to Marjorie as #5600/#5687/#5766, watchdog #5697, auto-pause shipped in #5825). It also killed the Monday 10-12 weekly run, which is why this plan arrives on a Thursday and why the calendar on main had expired on 10-11. So this fortnight plans 13 beats for 13 draftable days and no more: the standing reservations (4 October thread heroes, 3 weekly Blank Spaces timeline beats, 3 weekly news reserves) already claim 10 of 13, a 4-post launch arc does not fit in the remaining 3, and §1(a) forbids paying for one out of thread or timeline beats — so the Community Engine arc is deferred to the week of 2026-11-02 rather than planned a fifth time against a budget that cannot pay for it. Changes made this week: strategy PR #5871 adds a photo-library scale target (≥50 new never-used entries/week under 3,000) and a 'Photo supply' row to the weekly scorecard, answering Joey's 10-05 chat ask — evidence is that the sourcing engine landed zero photos on its two failed October runs and took the library 88 → 201 entries (186 never used) across five consecutive green runs since. Lessons ledger: L001 (photo reuse) retires as codified, superseded by check-drafts.mjs:checkPhotoReuse now that issue #4601 has closed and the check is live; new rule L002 says a Reddit reply target only reaches the owner when its reply-eligibility is confirmed, from his 10-06 rejection 'Don't show me posts that I can't reply to'.

needsFromMarjorie.ask: Decide where the social posting lane sits in the fleet's weekly token budget, so it is not the first thing starved when the Claude account hits its weekly limit
needsFromMarjorie.why: The daily draft run failed 10-12, 10-13 and 10-14, all three with 'reason: You've hit your weekly limit' in the run log, and the Monday 10-12 weekly plan run died the same way — four dark days, no post since 10-11, and the calendar on main expired on 10-11. Already filed as #5600, #5687, #5766 and watchdog #5697; #5825 now auto-pauses on the limit, which stops the thrash but does not decide what gets the remaining capacity.

needsFromMarjorie.ask: Make `node scripts/social/event-status.mjs` runnable on a clean checkout, or change the two runner prompts that tell an agent to invoke it with bare node
needsFromMarjorie.why: Bare `node scripts/social/event-status.mjs` fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on packages/core/src/vault-types even after a successful `npm ci` — @swift2/core's exports point at extension-less .ts sources, so it only runs under tsx (`node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/social/event-status.mjs` works). tree-weekly-plan.md step 0.6 and social-event-status.yml both call it with plain node; this run only got its reading by guessing the loader.

needsFromMarjorie.ask: Retire the two stranded Tree draft PRs #5443 (10-09) and #5495 (10-10), and confirm the already-posted 2026-10-11 Instagram item is no longer counted as a failure
needsFromMarjorie.why: Both PRs are still open 5-6 days past the 48h staleness window because the daily prepare job that runs retire-stale-drafts.mjs never started. Separately, social/failed/2026-10-11-speaknow-million-week-ig.json carries failureReason 'Still unposted more than 48h after founder approval' while social/posted/ holds the same item with platformPostId 18107359273946758 — it did post, so this week's scorecard reports 1 failure against a target of zero that is really 0. PRs #5857 and #5824 look like they fix this forward; the stale file and the two open PRs are the residue.

needsFromMarjorie.ask: Hold back Reddit reply targets whose reply-eligibility is unconfirmed, instead of surfacing them flagged as replyUnverified
needsFromMarjorie.why: Joey rejected a target on 2026-10-06 with 'Cannot reply to this particular post. Don't show me posts that I can't reply to' (social/feedback/2026-W41.jsonl). scripts/community/awareness-eligibility.mjs already resolves a five-state REPLY_STATES including 'unknown', but awareness-scan.mjs:238 keeps unknown candidates and only sets replyUnverified — so a post nobody can reply to still reaches his queue. Recorded as lesson L002; the fix is in a script outside this desk's rights.

needsFromMarjorie.ask: Add a posting-gap alarm: nothing new in social/posted/ for more than 48h opens or updates a watchdog alert and pings #longlive-tree
needsFromMarjorie.why: watchdog.yml caught the three failed daily-draft runs (#5697), but nothing alarms on the outcome. Had all three runs exited green while drafting nothing, the floor on detecting a dead account would have been the weekly Monday scorecard — and that Monday run died too, so the real detection lag this week was four days. A gap alarm catches a drafter that drafts, a poster that never ships and a stalled approval alike. Narrowed from the two-part chat ask on PR #5171: the lane-liveness half is already covered.
